feeds.title: Taliesin meets the vampires
feeds.description: Here you will find views and reviews of vampire genre media, from literature, the web, TV and the movies.

feeds.title: Fangtastic Books
feeds.description: Fang-tastic Books is the home of vampire and paranormal book reviews, author interviews and fang-tastic book giveaways. Fang-tastic Books was created by author and vampire aficionado Roxanne Rhoads to showcase paranormal books and their authors.

feeds.title: Vampires.com - vampire games, tv shows, movies, books, and photos
feeds.description: For real vampires, vampire games and tv shows, movies or films, and vampire books. Join us for new The Vampire Diaries, The Originals, True Blood, Twilight, Buffy the Vampire Slayer news, photos, and events.

feeds.title: Vamped - Vampire magazine
feeds.description: Vamped is a vampire magazine that features investigative articles, reviews, news, culture, interviews and more! Vamped is a general interest non-fiction vampire site. We publish interviews, investigations, lists, opinions, reviews and articles on various topics. Something unique to to sink your fangs into.

feeds.title: The Vampire Project
feeds.description: An online vampire research portal, with resources and information, terminology, folklore and historical writings, and otherkin related materials. All topics covered here deal with vampires or other kin.

feeds.title: Night To Dawn
feeds.description: Night To Dawn books feature science fiction, fantasy, dark fantasy, supernatural horror (especially vampire), and adventure. Night to Dawn offers vampires, mummies, zombies, and other monsters we know and fear. Features poetry, short stories, and illustrations.

feeds.title: Real vampires | Celebrating the culture of the Vampire
feeds.description: Real Vampire Life (RVL) is an E-Zine aimed at spreading, and promoting the sharing of, information about the real vampire and sub-culture life to as many people as it can reach. We want all our readers to celebrate the mystique, the style, the culture and the reality that is Real Vampire Life.

feeds.title: Vampire News
feeds.description: Vampire News compiles vampire related information from hand-selected sources around the net
